instruments.description: The payment instruments available for this payment. Each instrument is associated with a specific handler via the handler_id field. Handlers can extend the base payment_instrument schema to add handler-specific fields.

eligible_amounts.description: Business-computed caps for item-restricted tender programs. A business that accepts an item-restricted program MUST list it here on every response, with `amount` 0 when no line qualifies. Programs that are not item-restricted are never listed. An instrument whose `program` is listed here is restricted; see the Tender Programs specification.
